description: David asked where his todo items from his call with Austin (Ledesma, Solace) landed. Master searched OmniFocus and Obsidian for 'Austin' and 'Solace' but failed to cross-reference the calendar, which clearly shows a 3:30 PM meeting on Aug 10 with Austin. Instead of identifying the correct Plaud note via calendar lookup, Master returned the wrong recording (Stephen Johnson / Strategic Partnership) and presented those action items as Austin's. The Aug 10 calendar data was available in boot state.
correction: When a user references 'my call with [person]', always look at the calendar for that date first to identify the meeting, then find the matching Plaud note by time/title. Do not rely solely on name-matching in vault search.
proposed_fix: Add calendar-first lookup step when resolving 'call with X' queries: pull calendar events for the relevant date, match by attendee name, then find corresponding Plaud note by date + title proximity.
